story:
Ethan woke up feeling excited [emotion:QT/happy] because today was picnic day! His mom had packed a big basket with crunchy sandwiches and juicy berries. Ethan wanted to be helpful. [emotion:QT/shy] "Can I carry something?" he asked, looking at the large, patterned blanket on the chair.

[gesture:nodding-yes] [emotion:QT/happy] "Yes, you can carry the blanket, Ethan," Mom said with a warm smile. "It's soft and light."

At the park, they found a perfect spot under a giant oak tree. [emotion:QT/happy] The sun shone brightly. [emotion:QT/happy] Dad pointed. "Look, Ethan! The ducks are swimming in the pond over there." [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan saw a mother duck and her little ducklings paddling together.

"Now for the picnic basket," Mom said. It was round and felt very heavy. [emotion:QT/afraid] Ethan felt a little nervous because he thought it might be too much. He carefully picked it up, but it wiggled. [emotion:QT/afraid] "It's…wobbly," he said, his voice quiet.

[emotion:QT/calm] "It is quite full, isn't it?" Mom said gently. "Let's carry it together, so that it feels safe and steady. I will hold one side, and you can hold the other." She showed him exactly where to grip. [gesture:embrace] [emotion:QT/happy] With Mom's strong hand beside his, Ethan felt much better. [emotion:QT/happy] He walked slowly, feeling proud that he was helping. They carefully carried the basket to the big picnic blanket.

Once everything was unpacked, Ethan helped spread out the napkins. [emotion:QT/happy] He felt so good that they worked as a caring team. [emotion:QT/happy] "Thank you for being such a helpful boy, Ethan," Dad said, giving him a high-five. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan smiled, feeling warm and content, enjoying the delicious food with his family.

He carried his favorite toy car.

questions.correct_answer: He saw a mother duck and her ducklings.
wrong_answers: He saw some playful little fish.
He saw a big, friendly dog.

questions.question: Why did Ethan feel a little nervous when he picked up the picnic basket?
questions.correct_answer: He felt nervous because it was heavy and wobbly.
wrong_answers: He felt nervous because he was hungry.
He felt nervous because it was too dark.

questions.question: How did Ethan feel when Mom helped him carry the wobbly picnic basket?
questions.correct_answer: He felt much better and proud to help.
wrong_answers: He felt angry that Mom helped him.
He felt tired and wanted to rest.

questions.question: What was this story mostly about, Ethan?
questions.correct_answer: This story was about Ethan helping his family with a picnic.
wrong_answers: This story was about ducks swimming in a pond.
This story was about finding a lost blanket.

takeaways: Asking for help makes difficult tasks easier to do together.
Working with your family makes everyone feel important and cared for.
Feeling nervous is okay, and you can be brave with support.
